pages.text: Churches are rare and massive buildings dedicated to the worship of the Risus. Inside they feature a hallway leading to a central praying chamber, featuring three $(l:offsprings/angel)$(c)$(o)Blood Ophanims$() as well as an $(l:blocks/alteration_catalyst)$(c)$(o)Alteration Catalyst$(). Behind those there is a hidden entrance to catacombs filled with blood and $(l:offsprings/weaver)$(c)$(o)Weavers$(). The entire building is filled with $(l:offsprings/hex)$(c)$(o)Hexes$() making it extremely dangerous to enter. Adequate weaponry is a must.

pages.title: Church
pages.text: Churches tend to tower over their surrounding environment, making them easy to spot.
